title: seed
intro:
Initial growth after emergence.
   The initial growth process governs the growth of the crop until the point where
there is enough leaf area for photosynthesis to take over.

  < LAI     (DSLAI05 0.15 [DS])

            (InitCAI true) >

    DSLAI05 : number [DS]
     Parameter (default 0.15)
     DS at CAI=0.5; initial phase.

    SpLAIfac: plf [DS → <none>]
     Parameter (has default value with 4 points)

                                                  DS

                  (0.6 [DS] 1 []))

        Parameter description:

        phase.

       InitCAI : boolean (see section 4.1.2)
        State variable (default true)
        Initial CAI development phase.

sections.name: release
sections.desc: Initial crop growth is governed by carbon released from seeds.
sections.used: crop Winter Wheat JG Seed (see 29.45, page 177) .
sections.sig:

attrs.name: rate
attrs.doc: Release rate of seed carbon to assimilate pool.

attrs.name: T factor
attrs.doc:
Soil temperature effect on release rate. By default use the same as for mainte-
        nance respiration:0.4281 (exp (0.57 - 0.024 T + 0.0020 T2 ) - exp (0.57 - 0.042
    T - 0.0051 T2 )) This will give a rate of 1 at 20 dg C, slightly above 2 at 30
    dg C, and a bit below 0.5 at 10 dg C.

attrs.name: initial weight
attrs.doc:
Initial seed weight to use when not specified by the sow operation. If not
    specified here, specifying seed amount when sowing is mandatory.

sections.text:
Initial crop growth is governed by carbon released from seeds.
    Used by crop Winter Wheat JG Seed (see 29.45, page 177) .
   < release (C C )
                 (rate rate )
                 (T factor T factor )
                 (initial weight initial weight )
                 (DM fraction DM fraction )
                 (C fraction C fraction )
                 (N fraction N fraction ) >

       C : number [g C/m2 ]
        Optional state variable
        Unreleased carbon left in seeds.

       rate: number [h−1 ]
        Parameter
        Release rate of seed carbon to assimilate pool.

       T factor : plf [dg C → <fraction>]
        Optional parameter
        Soil temperature effect on release rate. By default use the same as for mainte-
        nance respiration:0.4281 (exp (0.57 - 0.024 T + 0.0020 T2 ) - exp (0.57 - 0.042

    T - 0.0051 T2 )) This will give a rate of 1 at 20 dg C, slightly above 2 at 30
    dg C, and a bit below 0.5 at 10 dg C.
   initial weight: number [g w.w./m2 ]
    Optional parameter
    Initial seed weight to use when not specified by the sow operation. If not
    specified here, specifying seed amount when sowing is mandatory.
   DM fraction: number [<fraction>]
    Parameter
    Dry matter content in seeds.
   C fraction: number [<fraction>]
    Parameter
    Carbon content in seeds.
   N fraction: number [<fraction>]
    Parameter
    Nitrogen content in seeds.
